message:
release: 0.2.145 -- sign in once: the PC client comes back signed in, and says why an account cannot

PC (Windows). GNLinkClient keeps a device credential (DPAPI) after a sign-in and comes back to the
host list without a password -- after a restart of the client, of the server, or twelve hours;
signing out ends it here and at the directory (fixed-server B, reviewed through 31d26aa + f9e7d45).
Accounts can be pending or disabled: sign-in and the Host window show the server's sentence, the
streaming host backs off and keeps its token (account-admin, reviewed through c5de3cf, 43fd898).
The directory serving both was deployed 2026-09-29 (19:57, 21:22).

Integration: main = 49891b3 (merges of 31d26aa, c5de3cf, 5aef51f; tree = 5aef51f + version line).
Verifier's independent runs on those commits: login_flow 127/0, client auto sign-in window 220,
Host sign-in window 52, host migration e2e 33, directory 661/0, account admin 113 x20. Codex: no
blocking defect (31d26aa's last P2 fixed in f9e7d45; c5de3cf "none").
Not verified: the Android app on a device (not in this release), the admin listener (off until the
NAS env is set), a relay cut at disable, an installed elevated Host showing the 403 sentence.

Product: version only. Test: none. Docs: none.
